name: termcanvas
//: Read the comment in .devcontainer/Dockerfile first. Containment here is a function of what is NOT mounted and NOT installed, so the mount list below is deliberately short. Before adding a mount, ask: does this need to be writable, does it carry a credential, and is there a path that does not require it? Adding a mount here is a security decision, not a convenience one.
//mounts-why: Eight mounts, and each is deliberate. (1) the repo-scoped PAT, mounted to the same relative path it has on the host so git-askpass.sh needs no container-specific variant. NOT the ~/.config/jef directory — that would also expose the jefscad and pixel-world PATs. (2) the spend-cap script and (3) agent-kit's instructions/ (AGENTS.global.md plus generated legacy files, at the old ~/tools/llm-instructions path) and (4) its worker skills where pi looks for them, all read-only so the agent cannot edit the rules it is operating under. (5) this repo's outbox new/ directory, the only writable mount besides the workspace: notify-jef drops one message there and the host's agentd validates it, rate-limits it and mails it to jef. The container never sees ~/.msmtprc, a recipient, or the outbox's sent/ and rejected/ (agentd invariant I5). (6) ~/tools/bin-container, read-only and on PATH, for notify-jef. (7) the wiki, read-only: the agent reads the distilled kb fundamentals, other projects' pages when a decision has cross-project implications — but cannot write, because the wiki is the one tier where an undetected error compounds instead of being caught. It is becoming a catalog maintained by the orchestrator; things worth keeping go in notes/. (8) the lab-bot's spend-capped OpenRouter key for pi, not a personal one. NOT ~/.ssh (the personal key reaches every repo on the account, including the wiki), NOT the rest of ~/.config/lab-bot (the bot's GitHub credential), NOT ~/.aws or ~/.azure, NOT the rest of ~/tools, NOT the docker socket (this repo builds nothing locally).
//initializeCommand: Runs on the HOST before the container starts. Creates this repo's outbox (new/ for the container, sent/ and rejected/ for agentd) so Docker does not create the bind source root-owned. The project name is the directory basename, the same value the mount above uses and the one agentd tags mail with (I4).
//postStartCommand: Links the global instructions into place for pi. The link points into the read-only directory mount, not a single-file bind, which would pin the inode and go stale when the host file is edited.
//features: No docker-in-docker: termcanvas builds nothing locally and needs no image builds, so the container gets no docker capability at all.

remoteEnv.//git: GIT_ASKPASS points at the tracked script that reads the mounted PAT. GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 stops a failed lookup from falling back to an interactive prompt, which in an unattended run hangs until the run is killed. GIT_SSH_COMMAND=/bin/false is a second line of defence behind the missing ssh binary: even if one is added later, git cannot silently fall back to SSH.

//customizations: No postCreateCommand: the build system is plain cargo with no venv to provision. Commit identity comes from the repo's git config, as on the host.
